question: Which of the following countries did India beat to win the Men's Hockey Junior Asia Cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India beat Pakistan** to win the **Men's Hockey Junior Asia Cup 2023**.
 
• The victory was a significant achievement for the Indian junior hockey team.
 
• India's performance in the tournament showcased their dominance and skill in the sport.
 
• The Men's Hockey Junior Asia Cup is a prestigious event in the junior hockey calendar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Men's Hockey Junior Asia Cup is organized by the **Asian Hockey Federation** (AHF).
 
• It serves as a platform for young hockey talent in Asia to compete at a high level.
 
• India has historically performed well in the tournament, often finishing at the top.
 
• The tournament helps in identifying and nurturing future stars of the sport.
